test_title: PYST 36: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

My sister and I work very hard / nevertheless my brother does not do / any task assigned to him.

options.text: nevertheless my brother does not do

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of the conjunction "**nevertheless**" instead of "**but**" or "**however**."
 
• "Nevertheless" typically begins a new sentence or clause and indicates a contrast after a period or semicolon.
 
• The correct phrase should be "but / however my brother does not do," aligning with the structure of the sentence.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My sister and I work very hard, but my brother does not do any task assigned to him."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "work very hard" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "any task assigned to him."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "My sister and I"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
